nodes.title: Life Orientation
nodes.description: Life Orientation for Grade 9 covering personal wellbeing, social and environmental responsibility, democracy and human rights, physical education, and career planning.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1: Development of the Self; Citizenship Education; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Development of the Self in Society
nodes.description: Identity and diversity: cultural identity, gender identity, sexual orientation; intersectionality; stereotypes and prejudice; managing conflict and diversity; building inclusive communities; planning for personal growth and future. Formal Assessment Task 1: Research task on identity and diversity.

nodes.title: Democracy and Active Citizenship
nodes.description: Active citizenship: voting, community participation, advocacy; South African government structures; accountability and transparency; media literacy and evaluating information; social justice and human rights activism; international human rights frameworks.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Sport and Movement Skills
nodes.description: Advanced sport skills and tactics in team games; leadership roles in sport; physical fitness testing and recording; sport and nutrition; career paths in sport and physical education.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2: Health and Reproductive Health; Environmental Responsibility; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Reproductive Health and Responsible Decision Making
nodes.description: Reproductive health: menstruation, conception, pregnancy; contraception and family planning; STIs and HIV prevention; abstinence and responsible sexual behaviour; teenage pregnancy: consequences and support; accessing health services. Formal Assessment Task 2: Project on reproductive health.

nodes.title: Environmental and Social Responsibility
nodes.description: Global environmental challenges: climate change, biodiversity loss, ocean pollution; South Africa's environmental challenges; activism and environmental movements; sustainable development and green economy; personal carbon footprint and reduction strategies.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Athletics and Aquatics
nodes.description: Athletics events and techniques; personal best improvement strategies; aquatics / water safety; recreational activities for long-term health; physical activity and mental wellbeing connection.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3: Safety and Security; Career and Study Choices; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Safety, Security and Crime Prevention
nodes.description: Crime in South Africa: types and causes; online safety and cybercrime; gender-based violence: GBV statistics, laws and support; community safety initiatives; personal safety planning; role of SAPS and justice system. Formal Assessment Task 3: Awareness project on GBV or community safety.

nodes.title: Career and Study Planning for the Future
nodes.description: Subject choices for Grade 10-12 and their implications for career paths; TVET colleges vs universities; bursaries and funding; writing a CV and cover letter; interview skills; entrepreneurship and self-employment; future of work in the digital age.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Gymnastics and Dance
nodes.description: Gymnastics sequences and routines; dance forms and choreography; physical expression and creativity; group performance and collaboration; appreciating diverse movement cultures.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4: Exam Preparation and Transition to FET; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Exam Preparation and Transition to FET Phase
nodes.description: Preparing for Grade 10: subject selection, study skills for FET; managing the transition from junior to senior secondary school; coping with change and new environments; support systems and seeking help; reflection on personal growth throughout Senior Phase. Formal Assessment Task 4: End-of-year test.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Consolidation and Personal Fitness
nodes.description: Personal fitness planning: designing a personal fitness programme; health-related fitness assessment; reflection on physical development throughout the year; lifetime physical activity and wellness habits.
